IS 15284 : Part 2 : 2026 Design and Construction for Ground Improvement - Code of Practice - Part 2 Preconsolidation Using Vertical Drains
ICS 93.020
ICS 93.020
CED 43
CED 43
1 SCOPE
This standard (Part 2) covers provisions on design and construction of vertical drains used for improving the ground such that the consolidation under preload is accelerated resulting in improvement of ground to carry envisaged loads.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provision of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards:
